notice: All curves are ESTIMATED archetypes of typical MEMS smartphone microphones, not lab measurements of the listed devices. Calibrated contributions welcome - see docs/MIC_PROFILES.md.

units.level: dB relative to 1 kHz (what the mic adds)

mems-bottom-port-strong-resonance.label: MEMS bottom port, narrow acoustic channel (stronger HF resonance)

mems-bottom-port-flat.label: MEMS bottom port, wide channel / well-tuned (mild HF resonance)

mems-bottom-port-damped.label: MEMS port behind mesh / recessed channel (damped HF, rugged phones)

mems-early-resonance.label: MEMS microphone, long acoustic channel / tablet (resonance ~7-8 kHz)

devices.label: Samsung Galaxy Tab A / Lite series
Xiaomi numbered / MIX / Civi flagship series
